text:
Seedance 2.0 just became available in CapCut, the only place that you can access the model to generate and edit in the same place. 

Their powerful editing capability makes the whole ai generation workflow a lot easier, no more switching tools to download and upload assets.

Here are where you can use Seedance 2.0 in CapCut: 
→ Web: Video Studio (omni reference supported)
→ Desktop: Media -> AI Video (t2v, i2v supported)
→ App: AI Lab, AI Generator, AI Video (t2v, i2v supported)
content:
Use Seedance 2.0 in CapCut Web via Video Studio to access omni reference support  
Use Seedance 2.0 in CapCut Desktop via Media → AI Video for text-to-video (t2v) and image-to-video (i2v) generation  
Use Seedance 2.0 in the CapCut App via AI Lab / AI Generator / AI Video for text-to-video (t2v) and image-to-video (i2v) generation
